ruleset.name: FormFabricator-Review
ruleset.description:
The checks WordPress.org's plugin reviewers run on the shipped code: output escaping, nonce verification and input sanitizing, the way their scanner reads them. It honours no phpcs:ignore comment and knows no custom sanitizer, so an input or an echo has to be checked, sanitized or escaped where it is read or printed, in a form the sniff recognises. Plugin Check and .phpcs-security.xml honour both and pass code the reviewers reject.
A release gate: zero findings. Usage: vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=.phpcs-review.xml
